svg.title: A compact DFlash2 draft ring preserves the full target token pool
svg.desc: The target keeps 1,048,576 physical token slots. Each of eight effective DFlash2 requests receives a page-aligned ring of 2,176 draft slots, derived from a 2,048-token window, page alignment, and an eight-token verify block. The eight rings total 17,408 physical draft slots. The drawing is schematic.
svg.title: A compact DFlash2 draft ring preserves the full target token pool
